data.title: Congo vs Cameroon Match Prediction 29 September 2026
data.content:
### Congo Team News

Congo have no record of fresh injuries or suspensions. So, I expect them to field a similar lineup to their first game. Goalkeeper Perrauld Ndinga is expected to start between the sticks. Bryan Passi and Christ Makosso are expected to partner at the heart of the defence, while Gestany Bantsiele, Christopher Ibayi, and Domi Massoumou are expected to lead the attack.

#### Congo Expected Line-Ups [...] Cameroon will continue to miss senior faces like André Onana and Vincent Aboubakar in this game. Blondy Nna Noukeu is expected to keep his spot in goal. Stéphane Keller, Samuel Kotto, and Duplexe Tchamba are expected to form a back three. Bryan Mbeumo and Danny Namaso are expected to support Christian Kofane in the attack.
